name: Store Crack
description: Strike a point and let a held measure of unmaking spill into the crack it opens.

name: Brimmed Guard
description: Hold a guard filled to the brim so that any blow that lands overflows it and breaks.

name: Draining Slip
description: Slip past a foe and let the stored qi drain out behind as a line of cracks.

name: Spill Break
description: Tip a measure of stored unmaking into a struck piece and break it through.

name: Pooled Unmaking
description: Let unmaking pool slowly about the foe's feet and eat at the footing.

name: Store Dissolve
description: Pour a little of the store over a cast technique and dissolve it in the air.

name: Unmaking Draught
description: Give an ally a measured draught of unmaking that dissolves a single curse and nothing else.

name: Overflow Ruin
description: Let the store overflow across the ground in a slow tide of ruin.

name: Store Annulment
description: Hold the whole store ready to annul any technique cast against the user or allies.

name: Brim Collapse
description: Break the brim of the field outward and collapse every structure in a broad ring.

name: Store Broken
description: The school's breaking of the full basin whose reach and ruin follow the qi stored within it.

name: Crown Crack
description: Strike with both tracks so two cracks meet at the crown of the target.

name: Two-Track Guard
description: Hold two tracks of ruin across the body so a blow breaks on whichever it meets.

name: Core Slip
description: Slip along a line from the core and leave a fracture where the foot has been.

name: Crown Flick
description: Flick a bead of ruin from each hand to meet at a single spot on the foe.

name: Convergent Break
description: Break through a guard with two lines of ruin that meet inside it.

name: Parallel Quell
description: Run the two tracks against a foe's qi and quell its two main streams together.

name: Track Unmaking
description: Unmake a cast technique with one track and its echo with the other.

name: Corelock Dissolution
description: Unmake the lock of a curse set on an ally's core and let the qi run free.

name: Crowning Ruin
description: Bring both tracks to the crown of a target and ruin it from end to end.

name: Dual Demolition
description: Demolish two lines of structure at once as the tracks run out from the core.

name: Terminal Breach
description: Breach the last guard of a single foe with ruin that no armour can turn aside.

name: Ruin Crown
description: The school's crown of ruin where both tracks meet and break a target by the weight of the core.

name: Razing Fist
description: Strike low with a fist sworn to level the works of the foe and no more.

name: Bracing Gust
description: Brace against a gust that splinters the blows meant for the user and allies.

name: Ruinous Slip
description: Slip away on the wind and leave a trail of loosened ground for the pursuer.

name: Gale Levelling
description: Send a levelling gale over a wide patch of ground and unmake what stands on it.

name: Sworn Quell
description: Quell the cast of a named foe with a gust that finds no one else.

name: Gust Annul
description: Annul a bolt of qi at its source with a swift gust of unmaking.

name: Gale Razing
description: Drive a gale that razes every work of hand across a broad stretch.

name: Sworn Demolition
description: Demolish the one structure the oath names with a gust that leaves its neighbours whole.

name: Windswept Annihilation
description: Sweep the wind across the field and annihilate the works of the foe while sparing the sworn.

name: Oath Razing
description: The school's oath of razing whose sweep follows the qi given and falls on the named alone.

name: Broken Fist
description: Strike with a fist that carries the breaking of a wind and shatters thin barriers.

name: Breaking Brace
description: Brace on a broken stance that gives under a blow and shatters its force.

name: Underbreak
description: Duck beneath a sweep and break the ground at the foe's lead foot.

name: Broken Draft
description: Drive a thin broken draft of ruin through the guard and into the vital centre.

name: Wind Quell
description: Let a wind that has broken pass over a foe and shatter each stream of qi it meets.

name: Snapped Tether
description: Snap the tether between a summoner and a bound thing with a hard gust.

name: Tether Remedy
description: Snap a harmful tether laid on an ally by a foe and let its loose end blow away.

name: Windfall Ruin
description: Drop a heavy fall of ruin from the broken wind onto a wide patch of ground.

name: Deep Annulment
description: Draw an annulment up from the core to unmake every technique that enters the guard.

name: Core Demolition
description: Demolish a core of stone or iron or qi from within with a thrust sworn from the core.

name: Broken Oath
description: The school's broken oath that ruins a target beyond mending by the weight of the core.
